intro: Century City is the Westside's office and shopping district, built on former 20th Century Fox backlot land between Beverly Hills and West LA. Most of the eating and entertainment centers on Westfield Century City and the towers along Avenue of the Stars.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A neighborhood bakery cafe with pastries, sandwiches and a small patio off Santa Monica Boulevard.
places.o: A pastry and coffee, or a sandwich at lunch.

places.w: An upscale Mexican restaurant with a lively bar.
A Tuscan trattoria from chef Agostino Sciandri.
places.o: Fresh pasta and a glass of Italian red.

places.w: A Japanese-influenced California restaurant tucked under a residential tower, with a leafy patio.
places.o: The black cod and a cocktail on the patio.

places.w: Nordstrom's in-store restaurant and bar, an easy sit-down break while shopping.
places.o: Lunch and a glass of wine mid-shopping.

places.w: A big open-air mall with a movie theater, a food hall and Eataly's multi-level Italian market.
places.o: Go on a weekday; weekend parking gets slow.
